headline: Vishal Nirmiti announces outcome of board meeting
hook: Routine board proceedings concluded at Vishal Nirmiti
summary: Vishal Nirmiti Limited has formally informed the stock exchange regarding the outcome of its board meeting held on October 15, 2026. Procedural disclosures of this nature are standard regulatory compliance requirements for listed companies.
